name: Home Depot SDC - Jersey Village TX

fieldNotes.truckGate: The truck dock court is fully enclosed by a black metal perimeter fence; a cantilever/rolling gate spans the truck driveway at the SE entrance (~29.8766,-95.5565). Confirmed in 2025 Street View — controlled truck entrance.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth anywhere along the fenced perimeter — Street View shows only the automated rolling gate, no staffed structure.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: True — a real truck gate with no guard shack, implying badge/kiosk/automated check-in.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Single rolling gate across one driveway lane; entry and exit share the one gate → entryExitTogether.
fieldNotes.drivewayShort: The gate sits close to Security Way with only a short paved apron between road and dock court — holds ~1-2 trucks, not a long queue.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Single dock bank along the W (truck-court) face of the building; no second separate dock cluster. Ship and receive run from the one dock line.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Leasing listing for 7301 Security Way states 67 numbered dock-high doors plus 4 semi-dock doors and 1 drive-in ramp; Street View shows the long single dock line with numbered doors (e.g. door 78 visible). Reported as 50+.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: 71 = 67 dock-high + 4 semi-dock doors per the Prologis/leasing listing.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Moderate trailer parking in the fenced W truck court; imagery shows the court partly empty (the 7301 building had ~161,099 SF marketed for lease, suggesting partial occupancy). 10-25 trailers detached at time of capture — flagged as uncertain.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Inside the Prologis Jersey Village industrial park at the US-290 / Beltway 8 interchange in NW Houston — dense urban industrial fabric.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: 44.74-acre lot per the Prologis/leasing listing for 7301 Security Way; building footprint ~296,839 sq ft.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Paved truck court inside the gate before the dock doors provides holding room.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: The HD SDC occupies one building (7301 Security Way, 'Prologis Jersey Village 4'); neighboring large warehouses in the same Prologis park are separate facilities/tenants.
